The 1952–53 season was '''[[Real Madrid Club de Fútbol]]''''s [[List of Real Madrid CF seasons|50th season]] in existence and the club's 21st consecutive season in the top flight of Spanish football.

==Summary==
During Summer [[Juan Antonio Ipiña]] took the job as new coach.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en/about-real-madrid/history/football-legends/juan-antonio-ipina-iza |title=The first Great Captain|publisher=Real Madrid C.F.|accessdate=2 July 2020|date=30 August 2014}}</ref> The squad reached a decent third place on League table three points below Champions [[FC Barcelona]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.bdfutbol.com/en/t/t1953-542.html |title=Real Madrid temporada 1953–54|publisher=BDfutbol.com}}</ref> Striker [[Pahiño]] chose to not renew his contract and left the club towards [[Deportivo La Coruña]] on 1 August 1953.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.phottic.com/es/photo/PaVOLmxA?j=eyJ0eXBlIjoidGFnIiwiaWQiOjM2OTJ9|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200728181709/http://www.phottic.com/es/photo/PaVOLmxA?j=eyJ0eXBlIjoidGFnIiwiaWQiOjM2OTJ9|url-status=dead|archive-date=28 July 2020|title=Pahiño signs new contract with Deportivo|publisher=phottic.com|accessdate=2 July 2020}}</ref> under pressure President Santiago Bernabéu reached and agreement with Joseíto and the forward chose to remain another season.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://elpais.com/diario/2007/07/13/agenda/1184277601_850215.html|title=José Iglesias, 'Joseíto', ex delantero del Real Madrid|work=El País|date=12 July 2007|accessdate=1 July 2020}}</ref>

In June, the squad reached [[1953 Copa del Generalísimo]] semi-finals being defeated after two matches by [[Athletic Bilbao|Atletico Bilbao]] with a 3–4 aggregate score.
